blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Airlines (PAL) has announced the cancellation or rescheduling of several domestic and international flights to and from Manila from Nov. 14 to 18 amid the arrival of delegates to the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits in Manila. In an advisory posted on its website on Oct. 30, PAL said affected passengers would be notified through email and SMS. They may also avail themselves of free rebooking, a full refund, or conversion to a travel fund through the airline’s website.
